findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "fmagenticl_resolve" appears informational but accepts parameters (environment) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "fmagenticl_resolve" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Deterministic sub-100ms lookup of a signed patch or verified workaround for an agent execution error. Accepts raw error traceback / exception strings (raw_error), package/tool names (target), or pre-computed SHA-256 fingerprints (fingerprint). Top supported targets: pydantic, litellm, crewai, langch" → after: "Lookup signed patch/workaround by raw_error, target, or sha256 fingerprint. Stateless, idempotent."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
